description:
The B2C extension: the overlay that reads and writes the four terms of model/b2c/0.1.json
    through the paths of the core model, and the gross authoring policies over it. The overlay
    sources are generated from the extension registry by esj-generator and are checked in; the
    core API stays the core API. The policies are hand-written and derive the net core terms
    from the gross figures a consumer was shown, with the arithmetic of EN 16931-1 and one
    report per run.
